name: Ragdoll
author: you
description: Real ragdoll physics. Press G to shove the character in front of you (Mr. Windz, Principal Gale, Miss Breezy and the residents) - they fly, tumble off the floor and walls, stay stunned, then get back up. Shift+G knocks over everyone nearby. X ragdolls YOU (the camera orbits your tumbling body; X again to get up).
